Evaluation and Comparison Workflows
|-- [M] Shared model boundary
|   |-- EvalsPage exposes prompt editing, run launch, output browsing and comparison
|   |   `-- Uses eval/compare APIs; reuses Mapping services for reference selection
|   |-- Application services coordinate work through injected contracts
|   |   |-- EvalRuntime.generate -> output, usage and optional execution identity
|   |   |-- Stores retain runs, prompts, experiments, sessions and judgements
|   |   `-- AgentContextLibrary + workspace records + project catalogs supply evidence
|   `-- Shared canvas model [shared A]
|       |-- CanvasHistory + checkpoints + diagram revisions + scene/edge/jump data
|       |-- MappingDocumentController applies edits; canvas transfer copies selections
|       `-- Generation, comparison and promotion all consume these same structures
|-- [M] Prompt authoring and input capture
|   |-- EvalPromptService: save / resolve / fork / archive / snapshot
|   |   |-- Internal validation checks workflow stages, template variables and lineage
|   |   |-- Changed prompt content appends a version; stale base versions are rejected
|   |   `-- resolve(promptId, version, workflow) -> pinned prompt
|   |       `-- Stage text + template base + content hash + cited reference text
|   |-- [D] Prepared EvalRun requires
|   |   |-- Workflow + exact prompt versions + model/effort + sample count
|   |   |-- AgentContext identity, name and content hash
|   |   |   `-- Generation resolves its snapshot and rejects a changed hash
|   |   |-- Canvas inputs captured at requested checkpoints [shared A]
|   |   |   `-- Optional earlier alternatives, canvas sets and layout template
|   |   `-- Cells keyed by prompt ID, pass and stage
|   |-- [C] CompareSessionService.capture -> copyCompareHistory
|   |   |-- Verify selected workspace view/checkpoint or resolve generated snapshot
|   |   |-- Copy selected endpoint and required diagram revisions
|   |   `-- Assign fresh history context; clear undo/redo and checkpoint ancestry
|   |       `-- Validate copied history before exposing it to consumers
|   `-- [O] Runs retain the evidence that gives their outputs meaning
|       |-- Later prompt edits do not alter captured stage text or references
|       |-- Reruns reuse matching pinned inputs and belong to the original root run
|       `-- Outputs belong to an AgentContext
|           `-- Canvas-only workflows create one from their captured inputs
|-- [M] Generation orchestration: EvalRunService
|   |-- Public entry points: start / prepareForReview / launchPrepared / cancel
|   |   |-- Request ID + request hash deduplicate launch; conflicting reuse fails
|   |   `-- prepareForReview captures a run without starting a runnable job
|   |-- [C] launchPrepared -> persist queued run -> execute
|   |   |-- Internal execute -> prompt/sample chains -> workflow stages
|   |   |-- Default concurrency: up to 3 chains
|   |   `-- Session-context delivery: one chain at a time within the run
|   |-- Workflow dispatch
|   |   |-- Roll-up: child + parent -> r2 -> g2
|   |   |   |-- [D] r2 needs complete child and minimized/full parent context
|   |   |   |-- [D] g2 needs validated r2 output and the pinned parent history
|   |   |   `-- [C] Save r2 before g2; failed r2 marks g2 skipped
|   |   |-- Alternatives: AgentContext -> one canvas per prompt/sample
|   |   |   `-- Optional previous alternatives and template geometry enter generation
|   |   |-- Diagram-change proposal: AgentContext -> exact proposal tree
|   |   |   `-- Preserve tree syntax for deterministic judging; render a preview canvas
|   |   |-- Linked canvases: AgentContext + captured canvas set -> one output bundle
|   |   |   `-- Delegates graph validation/materialization to the bundle builder below
|   |   |-- Few-shot refinement -> executeFewShot
|   |   |   `-- One prompt, five reference slots, three alternatives per round,
|   |   |       three evaluated rounds and a progress Judgement
|   |   `-- Diagram history uses an external history runner
|   |       `-- Ordinary start rejects it; cells refer to timeline/step artifacts
|   |-- [C] generateValidated: compose prompt -> runtime.generate -> materializer
|   |   |-- Prompt composition substitutes visible variables into saved instructions
|   |   |-- Valid result -> return materialized result and accumulated usage
|   |   `-- Validation failure -> at most two corrective generations
|   |       |-- Supply previous-output.json + validation-error.json with original inputs
|   |       `-- Runtime failures propagate; this loop retries validation failures
|   |-- [O] AgentContextEvalRuntime owns each model session
|   |   |-- No agentContext supplied -> delegate to CodexEvalRuntime
|   |   |-- With agentContext -> resolve messages -> create independent persisted session
|   |   |   |-- Shared resolved prefix/cache key; separate session audit identities
|   |   |   `-- No tools, automatic retry or compaction; samples do not share answers
|   |   `-- During prompt: collect response/usage; abort on signal or timeout
|   |       `-- Finally: clear timer, remove listener, unsubscribe and dispose session
|   `-- [O] Run lifecycle stays inside the coordinator
|       |-- AbortController and live run track execution; saves serialize snapshots
|       |-- Cell outcomes derive run status: finished / partial / failed / cancelled
|       |-- Restart fails unfinished local cells while retaining completed outputs
|       |   `-- Diagram-history recovery remains with its external coordinator
|       `-- Deletion aborts execution, drains writes and archives generated canvases
|           |-- Tombstones prevent late writes from resurrecting the run
|           `-- Root-run deletion includes reruns; context-output deletion keeps context
|-- [M] Output materialization and evidence retention
|   |-- Single-canvas step -> workflow materializer -> history [shared A]
|   |   `-- [C] projectCatalogs.saveMappingDiagram(type=generated)
|   |       |-- Record prompt/run/context provenance and canvas/checkpoint IDs
|   |       `-- [O] Run retains a pinned output snapshot and placement snapshot
|   |-- materializeLinkedCanvases(raw, inputs, namespace)
|   |   |-- [D] Complete bundle needs canvases + diagram revisions + valid jump graph
|   |   |-- Existing canvas -> clone input history, retain baseline, apply edits
|   |   |-- New canvas -> materialize diagrams and edges
|   |   |-- Validate entire graph in memory
|   |   |   |-- Every input appears exactly once; root and canvas IDs must resolve
|   |   |   |-- Jump source text and target canvas/diagram/concept must exist
|   |   |   `-- Every canvas must be reachable from rootCanvas
|   |   `-- [O] Bundle owns its complete jump lists and frozen proposed documents
|   |       |-- Replace old links so they cannot escape to live input canvases
|   |       `-- Store one EvalOutputResult in run.outputResults; cell stores its summary
|   |-- captureOutputResult -> pin an external change-session proposal
|   |   |-- Check project, session version and an eligible unpinned output cell
|   |   `-- Capture evidence without accepting changes or starting generation
|   |-- History-coordinated output -> timeline ID + step ID
|   |   `-- Payload stays in the shared checkpoint store
|   |-- GeneratedCanvasCatalog: list / read / readAll
|   |   |-- Reads generated representations from project catalogs
|   |   `-- Checkpoint reads first consult retained output snapshots
|   `-- Legacy generation bridge
|       |-- Reconcile chat candidates into eval records through LegacyGenerationAdapter
|       |-- Preserve original chat identities/settings for replay and cancellation
|       `-- Migration respects existing records and archived keys
|-- [M] Comparison and judgement
|   |-- CompareSessionService: create / createPinned / read / list / delete
|   |   |-- [C] Manual pairs -> capture inputs -> createPinned -> store session
|   |   |-- Whole-canvas panes retain cameras and optional paired diagram focus
|   |   `-- Diagram panes validate revision identity, line ranges and subtree targets
|   |-- [O] Session owns independent copies of selected source checkpoints
|   |   |-- Same source is reused within a capture; source undo archives are excluded
|   |   `-- Later source edits do not rewrite the comparison's evidence
|   |-- ComparisonGenerationService: start -> capture -> persist -> runtime.generate
|   |   |-- [D] Frozen diagram ASCII + revision IDs + evaluator prompt -> comparison
|   |   |-- Ordinary comparison output
|   |   |   |-- Resolve generated diagram IDs and validate slice ranges
|   |   |   |-- Require distinct alternatives and coverage of every selected canvas
|   |   |   `-- createPinned uses captured inputs -> publish comparison session
|   |   `-- Experiment comparison output -> resolveComparisonReport -> retain report
|   |-- JudgementService: reconcile / saveDeterministic / saveProgress / list / read
|   |   |-- [D] Sessions + comparison jobs + run provenance -> typed judgement records
|   |   |-- Results: canvas comparison, diagram comparison or comparison report
|   |   `-- Native results: few-shot progress and deterministic diagram-change assessment
|   `-- [O] Judgement owns its subjects and run attachments
|       |-- One result may evaluate outputs from several runs
|       |-- Evidence, evaluator settings, status and usage remain with the record
|       `-- Deleted judgements stay tombstoned during reconciliation
|-- [M] Experiment organization: ExperimentService
|   |-- Cases + conditions + phases + samples organize existing run cells
|   |   `-- [D] Stage output = run ID + cell key, checked against project/context
|   |-- save -> validate design -> prepareForReview -> retain prepared runs
|   |   |-- Map each planned cell exactly once to a sample stage
|   |   `-- Public review exposes summaries; launch bookkeeping remains internal
|   |-- [C] approve(expectedRevision, requestId)
|   |   |-- Persist approval receipt and starting state before launching
|   |   |-- launchPrepared each unstarted run; record progress after each launch
|   |   `-- Attach run/cell references to samples -> mark review started
|   |-- [O] Approved plans and their sample/input assignments cannot be rewritten
|   |   `-- Additional work can enter a new phase
|   |-- relaunch -> validate edits -> fork immutable prompt -> launch edited run
|   |   `-- Record another sample attempt with its source sample/stage
|   `-- judge -> gather finished proposal trees -> judgeDiagramChangeTrees
|       |-- [D] Exact retained proposal text supplies deterministic evidence
|       `-- Save Judgement and attach its ID to the selected phase comparison
`-- [M] Promotion into the project catalog
    |-- [C] promoteOutput -> promotionSource -> prepareOutputPromotion -> publish
    |-- [D] Promotion source must be a finished cell
    |   |-- Resolve history artifact, frozen output bundle or pinned canvas checkpoint
    |   `-- Selected canvas/diagram + reachable canvas dependencies -> documents
    |-- prepareOutputPromotion reuses shared history/transfer operations [shared A]
    |   |-- Copy the selection; allocate destination IDs and remap jump targets
    |   |-- Copy reachable dependencies so links do not point to unpublished output IDs
    |   `-- Bind generated placements to promoted placements for lineage
    |-- Destination
    |   |-- New canvas-project group -> publish copied canvases into that group
    |   |-- New canvas -> publish standard representations
    |   `-- Existing canvas -> require expected revision and no unsaved workspace edits
    |-- Request ID + signature -> repeat returns prior receipt; conflicting reuse fails
    `-- [O] Published documents have their own histories; pinned eval evidence is retained
